hero.title: Sometimes, You Just Need Another Opinion.
hero.subtitle: Get a specialist medical opinion from experienced healthcare professionals in India.
hero.description: A serious diagnosis can leave you with many questions. Whether you're unsure about surgery, exploring alternative treatment options, or simply seeking reassurance, a medical second opinion can help you make informed healthcare decisions.

introduction.title: Why Consider a Second Opinion?
paragraphs: A serious diagnosis can raise many questions and uncertainties.
Are there other treatment options available?
Should I seek another specialist's opinion?
Getting a second medical opinion may help you better understand your condition and the treatment options available.

overview.title: How IBN Sina Can Help
overview.description: IBN Sina helps coordinate specialist medical opinions based on the medical information and reports you provide. We connect you with appropriate healthcare specialists in India to help you explore your options.

steps.title: Share Your Medical Reports
steps.description: Upload your medical reports, scans, prescriptions, and other relevant documents.

steps.title: Case Assessment
steps.description: We review your medical information and understand your healthcare requirements.

steps.title: Specialist Coordination
steps.description: We coordinate your case with an appropriate medical specialist in India.

steps.title: Medical Review
steps.description: The specialist carefully reviews your medical records and provides a professional opinion.

steps.title: Receive Your Opinion
steps.description: You receive the specialist's medical opinion and can decide on the next steps with confidence.

importantNotice.title: Important Information
importantNotice.description: A medical second opinion is based on the information and medical records available to the reviewing doctor. It does not replace an in-person examination when one is medically necessary.

benefits.title: Benefits of a Medical Second Opinion

items.title: Greater Confidence
items.description: Gain additional clarity before making important treatment decisions.

items.title: Expert Medical Review
items.description: Receive an opinion from experienced specialists based on your medical records.

items.title: Explore Treatment Options
items.description: Understand whether alternative treatment approaches may be available.

items.title: Informed Decisions
items.description: Make healthcare decisions with better understanding and greater peace of mind.

cta.title: Request Your Medical Second Opinion
cta.description: Share your medical reports with our team, and we'll help coordinate a specialist review from experienced healthcare professionals in India.
